name: Grim Tales: Bloody Mary
storyline: You’re driving home from work when you get an urgent call from your favorite niece, begging you to pick her up from her boarding school. The teachers have gone missing, her classmates are becoming violent, and shadow creatures are haunting every corner. Search the school, but remember this one simple rule: Never look into a mirror after sunset. Bloody Mary is always watching.
summary:
Grim Tales: Bloody Mary is the fifth installment in the Grim Tales series by Elephant Games.

Anna gets a call from her niece, Jackie, begging Anna to pick her up. The teachers are missing, her friends are acting weird, and something is haunting her boarding school. Anna is on the way to save her niece. But beware! Don't look into a mirror or you'll be a victim of Bloody Mary.
